filtering_rules: Parse the English XHTML of OJ L 2025/1926. Keep rows only from tables whose header contains CN code, Description, Conventional rate of duty and Supplementary unit. Keep 4, 6 and 8 digit codes. Collapse whitespace, strip numeric footnote markers and leading hierarchy dashes. Drop blank descriptions and exact duplicate codes. Value is the code, one space, then the cleaned description. No subjective removal.
